title: Days Past Due and the Method of the RentGuard Late Charge
content:
## Billing manual — late charge method by lateness, RentGuard Renters Policy

Late charge method by lateness: the calendar days from the due date of the overdue installment to today are counted; when they are more than 30, the late charge is 25 percent of the unpaid part of the overdue installment, in place of the base with its additions; when they are 12 to 30, the late charge is the base with its additions plus 10 percent of the unpaid part of the overdue installment; when they are fewer than 12, the late charge is the base with its additions.

The unpaid part of the overdue installment is its billed amount together with the installment service charge billed with that same installment. The figure the method gives is rounded half-up to the cent once, on the final figure only.

| Calendar days from due date to today | Late charge |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 12 | The base with its additions |
| 12 to 30 | The base with its additions, together with 10 percent of the unpaid part |
| More than 30 | 25 percent of the unpaid part, in place of the base with its additions |

### Boundary days

- Day 11 after the due date: the base with its additions. Day 12: the 10 percent is added.
- Day 30: the base with its additions and 10 percent of the unpaid part. Day 31: 25 percent of the unpaid part alone.

### Hypothetical worked figures

Hypothetical inputs: unpaid part 42.50 USD, base with its additions 6.50 USD.

- 8 days past due: 6.50 USD.
- 20 days past due: 6.50 USD and 10 percent of 42.50 USD (4.25 USD), 10.75 USD.
- 45 days past due: 25 percent of 42.50 USD, 10.625 USD, rounded half-up once to 10.63 USD.
